reviews.title: It’s not doesn’t grasp any questions outside single answers
reviews.text:
So, I was using it for my anatomy homework, it was annoying how it wouldn’t solve questions with figures without pro, but it’s whatever, but on top of that it takes 100 years for it to process a problem, then on top of that, it doesn’t understand multiple choice questions, THEN on top of that, you can have the clearest picture and it will say “couldn’t detect problem” and finally to wrap it all up, you find out that each other those questions that it can’t solve or register, still counts as a token so you basically wait 30 seconds for it to say “we can’t solve this, btw that’s a token”. Finally, you don’t get that many tokens anyways.

Keep in mind, you get FREE 20 questions, figures, multiple choice, mathematics WITH clear instructions, using Question.AI, without paying any extra, and it operates faster with very very high efficiency…

With things like this being the standard or competition, this just has to be better.
